Read one ComplexHeatmap heat map's simple annotation tracks

Source: R/complexheatmap_annotation_layer_processor.R
complexheatmap_read_annotations.Rd

Finds the tracks (complexheatmap_annotation_tracks()), names their cells in the drawing (complexheatmap_name_annotations()) and reads each as a layer (ComplexHeatmapAnnotationLayerProcessor), for the heat map's own subplot after its heat layer.

Usage

complexheatmap_read_annotations(
  plot,
  view,
  layout,
  first,
  members = list(),
  h = 1L
)

Arguments

plot

The Heatmap or HeatmapList passed in

view

The capture, from complexheatmap_capture(), its heatmap the one whose tracks are read

layout

The heat map's layout: its title and its rows' title

first

The index the first track's layer is given

members

The list's annotations the heat map owns (complexheatmap_member_annotations())

h

The heat map's place among those read

Value

A list: grob, the drawing with the tracks' cells renamed; layers, the layers read; processors, their processors; unread, the names of the annotations drawn and not read
